measure_description: Uses the measurement data of sylvania/40A19FILCCLWIFI. SYLVANIA ships one lamp in three glass shapes (A19, G25, ST19) with identical electrical specs, the same FCC ID, and a byte-identical firmware image, so the filament and the power readings are the same. Only the Tuya product id differs, one per SKU. The ST19 was not measured separately.
name: SMART+ WiFi RGBW Color Filament ST19 LED Bulb (7W, 2000K)
